'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Nine [[civilian]]s are injured in a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] missile strike on a residential complex and a nearby building of the [[Security Service of Ukraine|SBU]] in [[Dnipro]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/missile-hits-residential-building-ukrainian-city-dnipro-ukrainian-mp-2023-07-28/ (Reuters)]
***At least four civilians are injured in a Russian shelling of a residential area in [[Beryslav Raion]], [[Kherson Oblast]], according to [[Governor of Kherson Oblast|Governor]] [[Oleksandr Prokudin]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/russia-ukraine-war-news-07-29-23/h_b5257d79e85d57840677576e6556825d (CNN)]
**[[2022–2023 western Russia attacks]]
***[[Russia]] claim to have shot down two [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[S-200 (missile)|S-200]] missiles, with the debris injuring at least nine civilians in [[Taganrog]], [[Rostov Oblast]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/07/28/world/europe/missiles-ukraine-russia-taganrog.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[2023 Nigerien coup d'état]]
**[[Niger Armed Forces|Nigerien army]] [[general officer|general]] [[Abdourahamane Tchiani]] declares himself the new [[List of heads of state of Niger|President of Niger]] following Wednesday's [[coup d'état]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-66337767 (BBC News)]
**The [[United Nations]] suspends [[humanitarian aid]] to [[Niger]] in response to the coup. [https://www.trtworld.com/africa/un-suspends-humanitarian-aid-to-niger-after-coup-attempt-14226631 (AA via TRT World)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Ford Motor Company|Ford]] announces that it will recall more than 870,000 [[Ford F-150|F-150]] [[pickup truck]]s due to concerns about possible [[parking brake]] malfunctions. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/ford-recall-f150-parking-brake-nhtsa/ (CBS News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Doksuri (2023)|Typhoon Doksuri]]
***The death toll from Typhoon Doksuri's [[landfall]] in the [[Philippines]] rises to 39, with about 42,000 [[internally displaced person|people displaced]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/typhoon-doksuri-leaves-39-dead-in-philippines-triggers-evacuation-in-china/2956340 (AA)]
***At least one person is killed and 68 others are injured as Typhoon Doksuri makes landfall in [[Taiwan]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/07/28/asia/typhoon-doksuri-china-landfall-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*Six people are killed when a small [[plane crash]]es in [[Calgary]], [[Alberta]], [[Canada]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/six-people-dead-after-small-plane-crashes-calgary-2023-07-30/ (Reuters)]
*Four people are missing and feared dead after a helicopter crashes off the coast of [[Queensland]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/four-feared-dead-australia-after-military-helicopter-crashes-2023-07-28/ (Reuters)]
*A [[Cessna Citation III]] goes missing with three people near [[Veracruz]], [[Mexico]]. All three occupants are feared dead. Search and rescue operations ongoing. [https://xeu.mx/policiaca/1282694/reportan-desplome-de-avioneta-frente-al-puerto-de-veracruz (XEU Noticias)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023 heat waves]]
**Preliminary data by the [[National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration|United States National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration]] reveals that the [[North Atlantic Ocean]]'s [[Ocean temperature|temperature]] has hit an all-time high of {{convert|24.8|C}}, reaching this peak several weeks earlier than usual in the year. [https://mb.com.ph/2023/7/29/n-atlantic-ocean-temperature-sets-record-high-us-agency (AFP via ''Manila Bulletin'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Haiti–United States relations]], [[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**The [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] orders [[U.S. government]] personnel and their families to leave [[Haiti]], citing "[[kidnapping]], crime, civil unrest, and poor health care infrastructure" in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/us-orders-government-personnel-family-members-depart-haiti-2023-07-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Taiwan–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Department of Defense|U.S. Department of Defense]] announces the provision of a $345 million [[United States military aid|military aid]] package to [[Taiwan]]. [https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/international/asia-pacific/1690606662-u-s-announces-345-mn-military-aid-package-for-taiwan (AFP via i24 News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Singapore]]
**[[Singapore]] [[executes]] [[Saridewi Djamani]], the first woman to be executed in the country in nearly twenty years. Djamani was found guilty of [[illegal drug trade|trafficking]] 30 grams of [[heroin]] in 2018. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-66333776 (BBC News)]
*''[[Disney v. DeSantis]]''
**A judge in [[Florida]], U.S., denies a request by entertainment conglomerate [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] to dismiss a lawsuit filed by [[Governor of Florida|Governor]] [[Ron DeSantis]] against their effort to neutralize the [[Walt Disney World]] district takeover in [[Orange County, Florida|Orange County]]. [https://apnews.com/article/disney-world-governing-district-lawsuit-2ec316b19599a7aae7c0ca44a9d53c8e (AP)]
*[[2023 Langweid am Lech shooting]]
**Three people are killed and two others are injured during a [[spree killer|spree shooting]] in [[Langweid am Lech]], [[Bavaria]], [[Germany]]. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-fatal-shooting-langweid-51278f20d8978e3c9934e088ea1e8f86 (AP)]
*At least thirteen people are killed during a police operation in [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo]], Brazil, in response to the killing of a police officer of the [[Rondas Ostensivas Tobias de Aguiar]] unit. [https://noticias.r7.com/sao-paulo/sobe-para-13-o-numero-de-mortos-em-operacao-da-policia-em-guaruja-01082023 (R7)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 WNBA season]]
**In [[basketball]], the [[Dallas Wings]]' [[Satou Sabally]] records her first [[triple-double]] with 14 [[Point (basketball)|points]], 11 [[Rebound (basketball)|rebounds]], and 10 [[Assist (basketball)|assists]] in the Wings' 90–62 win over the [[Washington Mystics]]. This is the Wings' first triple-double since 2005, and the first since the franchise moved to Dallas in 2016. [https://apnews.com/sports/basketball-satou-sabally-minnesota-golden-gophers-arike-ogunbowale-teaira-mccowan-9f138140f59f5059de4f4a5b767e0120 (AP)] [https://www.espn.com/wnba/story/_/id/38091392/sabally-1st-ever-triple-double-leads-wings-win-more-mvp-buzz (ESPN)]
